cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I saw you put yourself down as cover after giving me that lift. I've put my name over yours for the whole weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cover means I've agreed to work for you. I was giving you Saturday off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. And my name means you get Saturday and Sunday off. Take both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm already off Sunday to drive you to the airport. Your plane leaves at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll move my flight. Leave your name off the rota all week; I'll cover your holiday before I take mine.

reason: Make a misunderstood rota practice causal while retaining the escalating sacrifices and airport conflict.
